text:
lee: quick heads-up — PR #4582 is late-stage and green on CI. It's a runtime+orch change that adjusts KV cache eviction order and adds a small KMS key rotation hook. Need runtime + platform + security signoff before we put it in the next merge slot. cc @kevin @sophie @anya
kevin: looking now. main question: does this change affect hot-path latency? any perf numbers? :eyes:
lee: latency diff is ~0.6ms p50 on our internal bench for typical 512 tokens. I ran `bazel run //runtime/bench:latency -- --iters=200` — numbers attached in PR.
sophie: can take platform review after I confirm rollout config. which merge slot are you aiming for?
lee: hoping for today evening slot (18:30 UTC) if we can get quick signoffs, otherwise tomorrow morning.
anya: I'll run a security quick-scan. Is there any new network access or KMS scopes beyond existing infra?
lee: no new network access; KMS rotation hook talks to internal KMS via existing service account with same scopes. Diff is mainly in `runtime/cache/eviction.cc` and `services/kms/rotate.go`.
policy-bot: SCA scan complete — no high/critical findings. 0 new secrets detected.
kevin: thanks. quick smoke: `bazel test //runtime/...:smoke` passed locally for me. i'll give a final LGTM after a quick canary plan.
sophie: platform question — can we bind this rollout to an autoscale-safe canary? need owners for a 30-min canary and a fallback policy. who will own the canary?
lee: I can own the first canary run and monitor dashboards (latency, errors, token-per-second). rollback plan is the old config pinned to commit `a3f9b2c`. To rollback: `redwoodctl rollout set commit a3f9b2c --service runtime`.
kevin: I can watch runtime metrics for the canary window. Sophie, who owns the rollback on the infra side if we need to revert network config?
sophie: infra rollback handled by platform; i'll own the rollback coordination and ops steps. please paste the exact commands and the quick checklist here.
lee: checklist: 1) disable automatic autoscaling for canary group, 2) deploy canary (10% traffic), 3) watch `runtime.latency.p50`, `runtime.errors.5m`, `orch.kv.hits`, 4) if >3% error or p50 regresses >5ms, execute rollback command. commands: ```
redwoodctl rollout create --service runtime --commit HEAD --traffic 10
redwoodctl rollout set commit a3f9b2c --service runtime  # rollback
```
anya: I skimmed the KMS code. add one tiny doc note about key rotation TTL in the PR and i'm fine. can give formal LGTM after that.
kevin: LGTM pending that doc note and the canary run. if Sophie confirms the slot, we can merge and start canary. :thumbsup:
sophie: slot confirmed for 18:30 UTC. i'll start the ops runbook and post in #oncall when canary starts.
deploy-bot: merge window locked at 18:30 UTC for PR #4582. Automated pre-merge checks scheduled to run 18:20 UTC.
lee: thanks all — i'll push the doc note in 5m and queue for merge.
sophie: thanks — will monitor and ping if anything odd shows up.
kevin: standing by for final signal.
anya: once doc note is in i will add my LGTM.
lee: doc note pushed. marking PR ready. :rocket:
